You can make out an opened fridge. The fridge contains a red onion, a red apple and a white onion. Huh, weird. You can make out an oven. You can see a table. The table is massive. On the table you see a cookbook. You make out a counter. The counter is vast. On the counter you see a raw yellow potato. Suddenly, you bump your head on the ceiling, but it's not such a bad bump that it's going to prevent you from looking at objects and even things. You rest your hand against a wall, but you miss the wall and fall onto a stove. The stove is conventional. But the thing is empty, unfortunately. Oh! Why couldn't there just be stuff on it?

There is a closed frosted-glass door leading west. There is an exit to the east. Don't worry, there is no door. There is an exit to the north.

There is an orange bell pepper, a raw red potato and a red hot pepper on the floor.
